description: FEFF 8.5L against feffgpu, element by element and edge by edge (tools/validate_elements.py): for every element and each of its K, L3 and M5 edges the same recipe (an fcc cluster of the element, self-consistent potentials, paths to four legs). elements.npz holds, per compared case, k (1/A), chi of FEFF 8.5L and chi of feffgpu. r_factor_r_space: k 3 to 19, R 1 A to the path cutoff, k^2 weight; r_factor_k_space: k >= 2, k^2 weight.
